audit.whatIsWrong: diff was FAV while diffRating was 8.5/10 and the final rating line reads "Hard matchup" — the page contradicted itself. The level chart also disagreed with its own prose at four of seven stages: it gave Aurora nothing at Level 6 despite mid saying "Level 6 is your real window", and gave Heimerdinger Level 3 despite whys[2] calling it "a wash".
audit.why: 47.92% and a turret-zone lane is not favourable for Aurora. The packet chart already reads Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Skill / Aurora / Skill / Heimerdinger, which is exactly what the prose describes.
audit.corrected: diff HARD (matching diffRating 8.5/10 and report[14]); chart set to Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Skill / Aurora / Skill / Heimerdinger with ratings to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere and the Level 6 entry names "Between the Worlds".
audit.why: Aurora's ultimate is Between Worlds (140/120/100s). CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank — it does not get shorter as he levels it, which is unusual and changes how you count it. Hextech Micro-Rockets is 11/10/9/8/7s at 1325 range. UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: Real name and real numbers now in phases, breakdown.cooldowns, loading and the report.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated mechanics. (a) The page says Between Worlds makes you untargetable, in four places. (b) content.mid says his grenade "tracks you".
audit.why: Riot's text: Between Worlds leaps, releases a damaging slowing shockwave and creates a slow zone Aurora can teleport across — the invisibility belongs to Across the Veil. CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is "lobbed at a location", stunning only "anyone directly hit" and merely slowing surrounding units — it is a placed skillshot with a centre, not a tracking stun. A player told they are untargetable and that the grenade homes will stand in the nest and eat the stun.
audit.corrected: Untargetability reassigned to Across the Veil; the grenade described as a placed skillshot whose centre stuns and whose splash only slows. Also added Hextech Affinity: he gains Move Speed near his own deployed turrets, so chasing him into the nest is worse than it looks.

audit.why: The grenade's flat 11s is the punishable window and the page never gave it.
audit.corrected: Grenade 11s flat / 970 range, rockets 11s / 1325 range, UPGRADE!!! 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The "it is your KA answer; without it you are a immobile drain bot" template line appears in tradeBad, breakdown.trading, dontsFull[2].d and report[3].t.
audit.why: Ungrammatical and meaningless to a reader.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the actual consequence: stunned inside the turret nest.
